decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted  Development Order) 1995 or any Order revoking  and re-enacting that Order, no development within Part 1 (Classes A-H) [and Part 2 (Classes A-C)] of Schedule 2 of that Order shall be carried out without the grant of planning permission having first been obtained from the Council.

Reason: To safeguard the visual amenities of the area and to prevent over development of the site by controlling proposed extensions and alterations
in order to ensure compliance with the requirements of policies EN1, EN13 and EN19 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 2 - A minimum of 203m2 internal ground floor floorspace
    within the proposed development shall be retained
    permanently for use as B1c (within the meaning of the Use
    Classes Order 1987) and shall not be used for any other
    purpose within class B1.

Condition : 3 - No process  shall be carried on or machinery installed which is not such as could be carried on or installed in any residential area without detriment to the amenity of that area by reason of noise, vibration, smell, fumes, smoke, soot, ash, dust or grit.

Condition : 4 - No activity assoociated with the B1 use shall be carried
    out other than within the curtilage of the B1 buildings.

Condition : 5 - The whole of the car parking accommodation shown on the
    drawings shall be provided and retained permanently for the
    parking of vehicles of the occupiers and users of the
    residential units.

Condition : 6 - A detailed scheme with respect to the management of
    construction traffic shall be submitted to and approved by
    the Council prior to works commencing.

Condition : 7 - An acoustic survey of the proposed development site to
    determine the impact of the railway noise and vibration
    on the residential units shall be provided for
    consideration within the context of PPG24 by the
    Council prior to the commencement of the development.

Condition : 8 - Before the use commences sound insulation shall be
    provided for the residential buildings in accordance
    with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by the
    Council.

Condition : 9 - At 1 metre outside the windows of any neighbouring habitable
    room the level of noise from all plant and machinery shall
    be at all times at least 5 decibels below the existing
    ambient noise levels, expressed in dB(A) at such locations.
    Where the noise from the plant and machinery is tonal in
    character the differences in these levels shall be at least
    10 dB(A).

Condition : 10 - The details of the [layout, sections, elevations and facing materials] to be used on the building shall not be otherwise than as shall have been submitted to and approved by the Council before any work is commenced on the relevant part of the development. [Such details shall include proposed slab levels of the building in relation to the existing and proposed levels of the site and the surrounding land.] These parts of the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1 and EN13 [and EN31 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until full details of hard and soft landscaping and means of enclosure of all un-built, open areas have been submitted to and approved by the Council. [Such details shall include details of any proposed earthworks including grading, mounding and other changes in ground levels.] 

Reason: To enable the Council to ensure a reasonable standard of visual amenity in the scheme in accordance with the requirements of policies [EN15 if landscape details], [EN61 if trees only] [and EN35 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 12 - All hard and soft landscaping works shall be carried out to a reasonable standard in accordance with the approved landscape details [by not later than the end of the planting season following completion of the development or any phase of the development] [, prior to the occupation for the permitted use of the development or any phase of the development], whichever is the sooner. Any trees or areas of planting which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced as soon as is reasonably possible and, in any case, by not later than the end of the following planting season, with others of similar size and species, unless the Council gives written consent to any variation.

Reason: To ensure that the landscaping is carried out within a reasonable period and to maintain a satisfactory standard of visual amenity in the scheme in accordance with the requirements of policies EN15 [and EN35 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 13 - The windows at first and second floor of residential units
    numbers 11, 12, 13 facing Rosemont Road shall be constructed
    in obscured glass and fixed permanently shut.

Condition : 14 - Each of the 4 affordable flats as shown on drawing number
    P23D shall be constructed with rear upper ground floor
    balconies as shown with respect to units 5-13 on drawing
    number P23D.

Condition : 15 - Prior to any works of demolition or implementation of
    development, a 2.4m high barrier shall be erected 1m from
    the proposed building envelopes and the ground cover between
    the barrier and building envelopes covered to ensure its
    protection. The barrier and ground cover will remain in
    place until the works are implementation are complete.

Condition : 16 - A scheme to ensure the protection of existing trees for the
    duration of the construction works shall be submitted to and
    approved by the  Council prior to the commencement of the
    development. This scheme shall involve: details of the
    design of building foundations and layout, with dimensions
    and levels, of service trenches and other excavations on
    site insofar as these items may affect trees on or adjoining
    the site.

Condition : 17 - A survey of all existing trees on site shall be supplied to
    the Council prior to the implementation of the development
    and shall include the following information: location,
    species, reference number, girth, height, accurate crown
    spread. Where nearby excavations are proposed, the level at
    the base of each tree shall be included. Trees to be removed
    in conjunction with the proposed development should be
    indicated as such.

Condition : 18 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally.

Condition : 19 - To ensure that an equivalent ground floor internal
    floorspace is retained for use as B1c in the proposed
    development.

Condition : 20 - To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the
    area generally.
Condition : 21 - To protect the amenity of adjoining properties.

Condition : 22 - To ensure the permanent retention of the accommodation for
    parking purposes and to ensure that the use of the building
    does not add to traffic congestion.
Condition : 23 - To protect the amenity of adjoining properties.

Condition : 24 - To enable the Council to be satisfied that the development
    accords with policy with respect to development adjacent to
    railway lines.
Condition : 25 - To protect the amenity of adjoining properties.
Condition : 26 - To protect the amenity of adjoining properties.

Condition : 27 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 28 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 29 - To ensure that the landscaping is carried out within a
    reasonable period and to maintain a satisfactory standard of
    visual amenity in the scheme.
Condition : 30 - To protect the amenity of occupants of 28 Rosemont Road.

Condition : 31 - To ensure that the proposed affordable flats are designed
    with useable external amenity space.

Condition : 32 - To ensure that the remaining embankment is adequately
    protect throughout works of demolition and development.

Condition : 33 - To ensure that the remaining embankment is adequately
    protected throughout the works of demolition and development

Condition : 34 - To ensure that the development is undertaken in accordance
    with a acheme to ensure the protection of existing trees.
description:
Redevelopment by the erection of: 900m2 of B1
floorspace, 19 residential houses and 8 residential flats
(inclusive of 4 affordable flats) and parking for 22 cars,
development of a triangular site to the west as a community
play area, landscape works to and ecological management of
Rosemont Embankment,
as shown on Drawing Numbers; Site Survey/Site Elevations/
